verdict.rationale: First-party docs say what the response skill does: it shortens the agent's output. A community critique confirms the skill ships a trigger description stating when it activates, plus a direct /caveman invocation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of activation triggers and resulting behavior changes for every skill, a per-skill reference page, and independent confirmation that the docs let users predict behavior (one commenter found the caveman.skill file hard to read).

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me

citations.quote: A response skill shortens what it writes
its trigger description is ironically verbose
They credit Caveman with consistent output structure, intensity modes and the Auto-Clarity safety escape
